decks.notes: The principle of this deck is to control the game through disruption, removal, and powerful creatures. By using cards like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to strip the opponent's hand, combined with removal spells like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane, the pilot aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. This control strategy is complemented by powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and The One Ring, which can quickly close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Urza lands and Talismans to play powerful Eldrazi creatures and spells to control the game. The key strategy is to assemble UrzaTron as quickly as possible to generate huge amounts of colorless mana and cast game-winning threats like Karn, the Great Creator and All Is Dust. The deck also includes cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Kozilek's Command to disrupt opponents' strategies and ensure control of the game. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with powerful spells and creatures while controlling the board.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures such as Ulamog, the Defiler and Emperor of Bones, then use Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring them back into play for a devastating combo. Utilizing cards like Psychic Frog and Fallaji Archaeologist to manipulate the graveyard and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation and Thoughtseize to protect the combo and remove threats. The combination of instant reanimation and strong creatures make this deck a formidable force in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The key concept of this deck revolves around utilizing cards like Living End, Endurance, and Subtlety to manipulate the graveyard and control the board state. By cycling through cards like Street Wraith and Shardless Agent, the deck can quickly set up powerful combos and overwhelm the opponent with creatures like Waker of Waves and Curator of Mysteries. Additionally, cards like Force of Negation provide disruption while Boseiju, Who Endures and Otawara, Soaring City offer protection and utility. This creates a versatile strategy that aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure a victory through powerful creature plays.

This deck relies on assembling the Amulet Titan combo to ramp up quickly and put multiple threats on the board. The key strategy is to use cards like Amulet of Vigor and The One Ring to generate extra mana and play Primeval Titan to search for key lands like Vesuva, Valakut, and Lotus Field. This enables the deck to quickly generate a lethal amount of damage and overwhelm the opponent with powerful land-based threats. The deck also includes utility lands and creatures like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to further support the combo strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing Eldrazi creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes powerful cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to dominate the battlefield. With mana ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Curiosity, the deck can quickly cast its high-cost Eldrazi threats. Cards like All Is Dust and Malevolent Rumble help to clear the opponent's board, allowing the Eldrazi to finish the game. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent using a combination of control and powerful creatures.

The deck aims to control the game by ramping up mana with Eldrazi creatures and using cards like Through the Breach to bring out powerful Eldrazi like Ulamog and Emrakul early on. The deck also includes cards like All Is Dust to clear the board of threats, while using cards like Ugin's Labyrinth to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Boseiju, Who Endures helps to protect important spells from countermagic, and Gemstone Caverns provides an added mana advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with big, hard-to-handle threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells and removal, while also utilizing card advantage and manipulation to maintain dominance. The goal is to protect key threats such as The One Ring and Timeless Dragon, while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck has a strong mana base with dual lands and fetch lands to ensure consistency. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card draw and filtering, while Teferi, Time Raveler can stall opposing spells and abilities. Overall, the strategy revolves around outlasting the opponent and eventually overwhelming them with powerful threats.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea, the deck aims to consistently cascade into threats like Scion of Draco and Leyline Binding while controlling the board with cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety. The goal is to establish board presence early and maintain pressure on the opponent to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, as well as The Mycosynth Gardens, Gruul Turf, and Simic Growth Chamber. This allows the player to quickly cast Primeval Titan and search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive damage. The deck also includes cards like Summoner's Pact and Arboreal Grazer to help search for key combo pieces and maintain board presence. The overall goal is to assemble the combo pieces needed to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and lands.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Ulamog and Emrakul. It also includes control elements like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command to disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to cheat out big threats early with cards like Through the Breach and Ugin's Labyrinth, overwhelming the opponent with massive creatures. The deck also includes a mix of lands to ensure consistent mana production and some protection with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the late game with its powerful Eldrazi creatures.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments such as Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and The One Ring. By generating a wide board presence and using cards like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge for removal, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent quickly. Cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison also disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan, giving the deck an edge in the match-up. Overall, this deck prioritizes fast, aggressive plays to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells, while utilizing synergies between creatures and enchantments. It leverages the power of cards like Blood Moon and Goblin Bombardment to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also benefiting from the mana acceleration provided by Jegantha, the Wellspring. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain board control through a combination of efficient removal spells and proactive threats. Ultimately, the goal is to close out the game quickly with a mix of direct damage and combat damage.

The key concept of this deck is to use Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. By using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Ancient Stirrings to accelerate mana production, the deck aims to quickly cast creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker to control the board and take over the game. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy and clear the way for its own devastating creatures.

The deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures using cards like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries, while also utilizing cascade mechanics with cards like Ardent Plea and Shardless Agent. Once the graveyard is sufficiently filled, the player can cast Living End to return all creatures from the graveyard to play, potentially overwhelming the opponent with a sudden surge of creatures. The deck also includes counter spells like Flare of Denial and Force of Negation, as well as disruption cards like Endurance and Sink into Stupor to control the game until the combo can be executed.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to efficiently play Primeval Titan and search for key lands such as The One Ring and Malevolent Rumble to create a powerful combo. Amulet of Vigor helps ensure lands enter untapped, and Lumra, Bellow of the Woods and Aftermath Analyst provide additional utility. The versatility of the lands, including Urza's Saga, Simic Growth Chamber, and Lotus Field, allows for strategic choices in gameplay. Ultimately, the goal is to create a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with a strong combination of creatures and lands.
